category: market data API (US quotes, company news, fundamentals, WebSocket)

free_tier.stated: Free plan USD 0/month: 60 API calls/minute; on top of every plan's limit, 30 API calls/second
free_tier.notes: No daily cap is stated. The free column covers US data: company news for 1 year, earnings calendar for 1 month, EPS surprises for 4 quarters, and a WebSocket of 50 symbols. The Quote endpoint is marked High Usage, not Premium. Candles (OHLCV), tick data, historical NBBO, last bid-ask, splits and most estimates endpoints are marked Premium in the API documentation, so the free plan carries no historical price bars. The All-In-One plan is USD 3500/month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: one JSON response per call; the filings endpoint returns up to 250 documents per call

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the call rate bounds what a free key can pull

interface_detail: REST under https://finnhub.io/api/v1 with token=KEY in the URL or an X-Finnhub-Token header; a WebSocket stream of up to 50 symbols on the free plan.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; a WebSocket client for the stream
chaining: A free real-time US quote and news feed at 60 calls a minute with no historical bars; history comes from another record, such as Alpha Vantage weekly or monthly series, Twelve Data daily series or Massive Basic end-of-day bars.

limits.value: 60 API calls per minute on the free plan
30 API calls per second on every plan

limits_note: Bulk path: filings metadata only. The filings endpoint names a Kaggle dataset, SEC Filings 1994-2020, published by Finnhub for bulk download; prices, candles and news have no bulk path.
binding_note: 60 calls a minute is the ceiling a free key meets; the 30-per-second limit binds only bursts.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for a name, an email and a password, behind a reCAPTCHA; it has no card field. Signing up confirms non-professional status, and the terms use the name and email to file a non-professional subscriber form. A third-party integration guide reports an email verification link before the key is shown. A call without a key answers HTTP 401 with 'Please use an API key.'

reliability_note: Inactive users are deleted from time to time; a deleted account needs a new signup.
confidence_note: The rate and the plan columns are documented on the pricing page and the API documentation. A keyless probe confirmed the API answers and demands a key; the 60-per-minute cut-off needs a free key to measure.
